import sys

    def __init__(self):
        self.out = sys.stdout
        self.sc = sys.stdin
        self.oo = []
        self.oh = []
        self.__ = 1
        self.ii = []
        self.jj = []
        self.cc = []
        self.cost = []
        self.cost_ = []
        self.m_ = 0
        self.pi = []
        self.dd = []
        self.ff = []
        self.ae = []
        self.pq = []
        self.iq = []
        self.n_ = 0
        self.cnt = 0

    def link(self, o, h):
        self.oo.append(o)
        self.oh.append(h)
        return self.__
    def init(self):
        self.oo = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.oh = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.ii = [0] * self.m_
        self.jj = [0] * self.m_
        self.cc = [0] * (self.m_ << 1)
        self.cost = [0] * self.m_
        self.cost_ = [0] * self.m_
        self.pi = [float('inf')] * self.n_
        self.dd = [0] * self.n_
        self.ff = [0] * self.n_
        self.ae = [0] * self.n_
        self.pq = [0] * (1 + self.n_)
        self.iq = [0] * self.n_
        self.m_ = 0
    def link_(self, i, j, c, co):
        h = self.m_
        self.ii[h] = i
        self.jj[h] = j
        self.cc[h << 1] = c
        self.cost[h] = co
        self.ae[i] = self.link(self.ae[i], h << 1)
        self.ae[j] = self.link(self.ae[j], h << 1 | 1)
    def less(self, u, v):
        return self.pi[u] < self.pi[v] or (self.pi[u] == self.pi[v] and self.dd[u] < self.dd[v])
    def i2(self, i):
        return (i * 2) if (i * 2) <= self.cnt else 0
    def pq_up(self, u):
        i, j, v = 0, 0, 0
        for i in range(self.iq[u], 0, -1):
            j = i // 2
            if j > 0 and self.less(u, v := self.pq[j]):
                self.pq[self.iq[v]] = v
                self.iq[u] = self.iq[v]
                self.pq[self.iq[u]] = u
                self.iq[v] = i
                self.pq[self.iq[v]] = v
                i = self.iq[u]
                j = i // 2
    def pq_dn(self, u):
        i, j, v = 0, 0, 0
        for i in range(self.iq[u], 0, -1):
            j = self.i2(i)
            if j > 0 and self.less(v := self.pq[j], u):
                self.pq[self.iq[v]] = v
                self.iq[u] = self.iq[v]
                self.pq[self.iq[u]] = u
                self.iq[v] = i
                self.pq[self.iq[v]] = v
                i = self.iq[u]
                j = i // 2
    def pq_add_last(self, u):
        self.pq[self.iq[u] = self.cnt + 1] = u
        self.cnt += 1
    def pq_remove_first(self):
        u = self.pq[1]
        v = self.pq[self.cnt]
        if v != u:
            self.iq[v] = 1
            self.pq_dn(v)
        self.iq[u] = 0
        self.pq[self.iq[u]] = 0
        self.cnt -= 1
        return u
    def dijkstra(self, s, t):
        self.pi = [float('inf')] * self.n_
        self.pi[s] = 0
        self.pq_add_last(s)
        while self.cnt > 0:
            i = self.pq_remove_first()
            d = self.dd[i] + 1
            for o in self.oo[self.ae[i]:]:
                h_ = self.oh[o]
                if self.cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    j = i ^ self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]

                            self.pq_add_last(j)
                        self.pi[j] = p
                        self.dd[j] = d
                        self.ff[j] = h_
                        self.pq_up(j)
        return self.pi[t] != float('inf')
    def trace(self, s, t):
        while t != s:
            h_ = self.ff[t]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= 1
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            t ^= self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]
        return 1
    def edmonds_karp(self, s, t):
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.pi[j] = min(self.pi[j], self.pi[i] + self.cost[h])
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.cost_[h] = self.cost[h] + self.pi[i] - self.pi[j]
        f = 0
        while self.dijkstra(s, t):
            f += self.trace(s, t)
            for h in range(self.m_):
                i = self.ii[h]
                j = self.jj[h]
                if self.pi[i] != float('inf') and self.pi[j] != float('inf'):
                    self.cost_[h] += self.pi[i] - self.pi[j]
        ans = 0
        for h in range(self.m_):
            ans += self.cc[h << 1 | 1] * self.cost[h]
        return ans

        self.n_ = 1 + n + 26 + 1
        self.m_ = n + n * 26 + 26

        for i in range(n * 2):
            kk[ord(cc[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
        for a in range(26):
            self.link_(1 + n + a, self.n_ - 1, kk[a], 0)
        print(-self.edmonds_karp(0, self.n_ - 1))
